📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 downside：(-overnight.clip(upper=0.0) + -intraday.clip(upper=0.0)).滚动窗口(42, min_periods=42).mean()
  2. 计算 upside：(overnight.clip(lower=0.0) + intraday.clip(lower=0.0)).滚动窗口(42, min_periods=42).mean()
  3. 计算 total_magnitude：(downside + upside)
  4. 计算 imbalance：(downside - upside) / total_magnitude
  5. 计算 participation_weight：0.85 + 0.15 * volume_ratio.clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_session_magnitude_imbalance_volume_weighted_42d(df): """Smoothed session ">class="kw">return magnitude imbalance with bounded volume participation weighting.""" df_copy = df.copy() overnight, intraday = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]) downside = (-overnight.clip(upper=0.0) + -intraday.clip(upper=0.0)).rolling(42, min_periods=42).mean() upside = (overnight.clip(lower=0.0) + intraday.clip(lower=0.0)).rolling(42, min_periods=42).mean() total_magnitude = (downside + upside).replace(0.0, np.nan) imbalance = (downside - upside) / total_magnitude _, _, volume_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20) participation_weight = 0.85 + 0.15 * volume_ratio.clip(lower=0.0, upper=2.0) df_copy["factor_session_magnitude_imbalance_volume_weighted_42d"] = (imbalance * participation_weight).replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan) "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_session_magnitude_imbalance_volume_weighted_42d"]
